paragraphs.text: Joel Pedraza Villaseñor participated in Shipment NLD-10-01 on 2010-11-26. Círculo del Valle Quieto was linked to Shipment NLD-10-01 on 2010-11-26. Shipment NLD-10-01 occurred at Nuevo Laredo on 2010-11-26. A cooperating defendant with prior employment on the Laredo side of the crossing stated that Pedraza, then the Reynosa plaza boss for Círculo del Valle Quieto and known as El Diez, arranged a load of 35 kg of cocaine through the Nuevo Laredo commercial crossing in a tractor-trailer with legitimate freight bound for Atlanta. The defendant described the load as a trial of the Nuevo Laredo lanes by a plaza boss who normally worked Reynosa.

Autotransportes Sierra Madre Norte supported Shipment NLD-10-01 on 2010-11-26. Tráiler Sierra Madre Doce was involved in Shipment NLD-10-01 on 2010-11-26. Joel Pedraza Villaseñor used DEMO-TEL-00003 on 2010-11-26. The defendant identified the trucking firm as the registered carrier and the unit as one of its regular units on the Monterrey to Laredo run. The telephone identifier above was the one Pedraza used to confirm the crossing with the defendant's employer. The defendant stated that the paperwork was in order and that the load crossed without inspection.

Círculo del Valle Quieto controlled Nuevo Laredo plaza from 2010-09-01 until 2019-05-23. Aurelio Castañón Vidaurri led Círculo del Valle Quieto from 2010-09-01 until 2019-05-23. Joel Pedraza Villaseñor was a member of Círculo del Valle Quieto from 2010-09-01 until 2020-01-10. The defendant characterized the Nuevo Laredo crossing as fully under the network's control through its customs contacts and described Castañón as the owner of both the firm and the network. Pedraza was described as a founding member who answered directly to Castañón.

Fausto Elizondo Marroquín owned Autotransportes Sierra Madre Norte on 2010-10-01. Cristóbal Arizpe Dávalos was the nominee owner of Autotransportes Sierra Madre Norte on 2010-10-01. The defendant stated that the firm's registered owner is Elizondo, called El Capataz, who runs the trucking logistics for the network, and that the lawyer Arizpe, known as El Perito, appears on the registration as a nominee. The reporting office assesses the defendant as having direct knowledge of the firm's paperwork from prior employment. The company and vehicle names in this report were checked against registry extracts.
